paper_Slit2_trabecular_associated.source: Exact Table3 markers; paper spatially associates this state with trabeculae. Remove Gm35041 for interpretable functional score sensitivity; anchor Slit2.
paper_Slit2_trabecular_associated.limitations: No independent anatomical assignment of our nuclei; conduction/trabecular overlap is expected.

paper_Ankrd1_mechanosensitive_associated.source: Exact Table3 markers; anchor Ankrd1. Atf3 is named separately in main text but overlaps immediate-early response.
paper_Ankrd1_mechanosensitive_associated.limitations: Expression does not quantify force/strain or establish pathological stress. Developmental and preparation responses remain alternatives.

paper_Ddc_reference.limitations: Not an established transmural location; cross-check against maturation and metabolic programs.

HIF_response_curated_subset.source: Selected members of HALLMARK_HYPOXIA v7.0 (human symbols mapped by conventional one-to-one mouse symbol spelling; verify in dataset). Mirror raw URL below.
HIF_response_curated_subset.limitations: Subset selection is analyst-curated, not a validated oxygen assay. HIF1A activation is largely posttranslational; Hif1a RNA alone is not an oxygen measurement.

glycolytic_enzyme_program.limitations: Metabolic transcription is not metabolic flux or hypoxia; substantial HIF overlap requires leave-overlap sensitivity.

nuclear_OXPHOS_program.limitations: Exclude mitochondrial-transcript genes from this score to avoid treating capture/QC fraction as oxygen exposure. Nuclear transcript abundance is not respiration.

fatty_acid_oxidation_program.source: Analyst-curated canonical FAO/ETF machinery; OXPHOS/FAO context rather than a validated spatial signature.
fatty_acid_oxidation_program.limitations: FAO and OXPHOS have shared components; test overlap sensitivity and maturation confounding.

structural_mechanocoupling_apparatus.source: Analyst-curated costamere/cytoskeletal coupling machinery; reviews DOI10.1152/ajpheart.00749.2005 and10.1007/s10237-012-0419-2.
structural_mechanocoupling_apparatus.limitations: Constitutive apparatus expression is not proof that mechanotransduction is activated or force is higher.

immediate_early_preparation_response_con.source: Analyst-curated IEG/heat-shock control, dissociation-effect context DOI10.1038/nmeth.4437.
immediate_early_preparation_response_con.limitations: Also real physiological responses. snRNA reduces some dissociation artifacts but does not eliminate preparation confounding; shared Atf3/Fos/Jun must not define oxygen/mechanics by themselves.

embryonic_compact_context_only.source: Miao etal2018 DOI10.1038/s41598-018-20917-w explicit compact-zone list.
embryonic_compact_context_only.limitations: Morphogenesis context; Hey2 is also present at trabecular bases/other cardiac sites. Do not require this embryonic panel to diagnose P14/P21 wall identity.

embryonic_trabecular_context_only.limitations: Developmental rather than adult transmural signature; overlap with conduction, proliferation and maturation.
